speakers.title: Siakale mo'ui 'a e tokotaha lea
speakers.description: Puleʻi ʻa e ngaahi kaveingá pea hiki ʻa e tokotaha lea takitaha ʻo fakafou ʻi he palani, fakaafeʻi, tali, fakapapauʻi, mo fakakakato.
speakers.topicPlaceholder: Ko e hā ʻe lea ʻaki ʻe he tokotaha lea ko ʻení?
speakers.topicRequired: Kaveinga 'oku fiema'u kimu'a pea toki fakapapau'i.
speakers.noSpeakers: ‘Ikai ha kau malanga ‘e vahe ki he ngaahi fakatahá.

errors.load: Na'e 'ikai lava ke uta 'a e feitu'u ngaue 'o e siakale mo'ui 'o e tokotaha lea.
